LOVENEESH KUMAR

📱 +91-7017801366 | ✉️ lkverma15891@gmail.com 

Professional Summary

Accomplished IT professional with 10+ years of experience, including 5+ years specializing as a DevOps Engineer. Skilled in CI/CD automation, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM), Cloud Engineering (Azure, AWS), Kubernetes, Docker, Linux administration, and Networking. Experienced in designing and deploying secure, scalable, and cost-efficient cloud solutions while ensuring compliance, reliability, and high availability. Strong track record of building automated pipelines, improving release cycles, and enhancing operational efficiency in enterprise environments. Additional expertise in telecom protocol testing and cross-functional collaboration to drive digital transformation initiatives.

Core Skills

CI/CD Tools: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions with YAML.

Python

IaC & Configuration Mgmt: Terraform, ARM Templates

Cloud Platforms: Microsoft Azure, AWS, OpenStack

Containers & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes (AKS)

Version Control: Git, GitHub, GitLab

Monitoring & Security: TFSec, TFlint, Prometheus, Grafana

Ticketing & Collaboration: Jira, Azure Boards

Networking & Protocols: TCP/IP, UDP, TLS, HTTP/HTTPS, SIP, RTP, Diameter, VoLTE/5G

Testing and analysis tool: Wireshark, J-meter,

Career Timeline

DevOps Engineer – Hughes Systique Corporation | March 2025 – Present

DevOps Engineer – L&T Technology Services | Sep 2022 – March 2025

Cloud Engineer – Capgemini Engineering | Feb 2021 – AUg 2022

Deputy Manager – RJIO | Aug 2022 – Feb 2022

Protocol Test Engineer – Jnet Technology Pvt Ltd.| July 2017 – Jul 2021

Test Engineer – Kutumbh Care Pvt Ltd. | Nov 2015 – Feb 2017

Professional Experience

DevOps Engineer | Hughes Systique Corporation 

March 2025 – Present

Automated CI/CD Pipelines: Leveraged Azure DevOps and GitHub Action to build fully automated end-to-end pipelines for build, test, and deployment processes.

Plan and execute the DevOps pipeline that supports the application life cycle across the DevOps toolchain from planning, building, testing, staging, release, configuration, and monitoring.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Utilized Terraform and ARM templates to declaratively define, provision, and manage Azure infrastructure, ensuring repeatability and consistency.

Secure IaC Practices: Integrated TFSec and TFlint into pipelines for proactive Terraform code analysis, ensuring security and compliance.

Cloud Architecture Design: Designed and implemented a robust hub-and-spoke network topology in Azure to optimize resource connectivity, management, and security.

IaC Governance & Optimization: Applied Terraform best practices for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and security, enhancing reliability and scalability of cloud environments.

Containerization & Orchestration: Used Docker and Kubernetes to set up and manage containerized infrastructure for deploying microservice applications.

Design, deploy, and manage Kubernetes clusters on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

Version Control & Collaboration: Used Git for version control and GitHub & GitLab for source code management.

Bug Tracking Tools: Experience using tools like Azure DevOps Board and Jira for issue tracking and management.

DevOps Engineer | L&T Technology Services

Sep 2022 – Dec 2024

Built CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps to automate build and deployment workflows.

Provisioned Core Azure Resources including Resource Groups, VNets, Subnets, Key Vaults, Bastion, Load Balancers, VMs, NSGs, Web Apps, SQL Servers/Databases, Storage Accounts, and ExpressRoute.

Automated Azure infrastructure provisioning with Terraform.

Designed scalable cloud architecture with hub-and-spoke networking.

Managed AKS clusters with auto-scaling and self-healing workloads.

Used Docker and Kubernetes to set up and manage containerized infrastructure for deploying microservice applications.

Configure Kubernetes auto-provisioning, auto-scaling of CI/CD job/build agents, runners, and nodes.

Used GitHub/GitLab for collaboration & version control.

Cloud Engineer | Capgemini Engineering

Feb 2021 – Aug 2022

Managed Azure infrastructure using Terraform & Azure Portal.

Automated deployments with Azure Pipelines (Classic & YAML).

Provisioned VMs, Load Balancers, Key Vaults, SQL DBs, Storage Accounts.

Provisioned Core Azure Resources including Resource Groups, VNets, Subnets, Key Vaults, Bastion, Load Balancers, VMs, NSGs, Web Apps, SQL Servers/Databases, Storage Accounts, etc.

Deployed applications in Docker & Kubernetes clusters.

Deputy Manager | RJIO

Aug 2021 – Feb 2022

Deployed 5G applications on VNF/CNF using CBAM & Docker/Kubernetes.

Set up cloud infra on OpenStack & AWS.

Prepared HLD, LLD, deployment artifacts (JSON/CIQ).

Integrated & validated IMS/VoLTE scenarios.

RF Engineer | Jnet Technology Pvt. Ltd.

Jul 2017 – Jul 2021

Performed modem validation & troubleshooting for LTE/5G/IMS.

Debugged VoLTE, VoNR, VoWiFi, eCall, DSDS issues.

Analyzed logs (Wireshark, TCP Dump) for SIP, RTP, Diameter.

Executed interoperability and compliance testing (3GPP standards).

Test Engineer | 6 Kutumbh Care Pvt Ltd.

Nov 2015 – Feb 2017

Conducted LTE protocol testing (Attach, RACH, RRC, IMS registration).

Validated handover, reselection, throughput, QoS & latency.

Performed KPI-based testing using TEMS Discovery/Investigation.

Education

🎓 Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Electronics & Communication – TMU, 2013

Certifications

Kubernetes / Docker Fundamentals

Telecom Protocol Testing Certification
